content.content: When invoked as `deccy record <path>... --to <id>` and a named path cannot be placed — it names no working-copy edit, or the `--to` node does not own it — the deccy CLI shall refuse the invocation, naming the path, and place nothing.
content.rationale: The form places the named edits, and confinement forbids landing one outside its owning change; a path that names no edit or belongs to another node makes the invocation unfulfillable, so it refuses whole rather than placing a subset. Naming the path keeps the refusal actionable without re-deciding ownership.
